## Meaning

This monitor fired because extrapolating the recent trend, the resource is projected to cross its limit inside the forecast horizon. It has NOT crossed it yet — the lead time is the point of this alert.

Query:

```
max(next_1d):forecast(sum:acme.saas.api_calls{__SCOPE__} by {service}.as_count() / avg:acme.saas.api_quota{__SCOPE__} by {service}, 'linear', 1, interval='60m', history='1w') > 0.9
```

**Design note.** Vendor API quotas reset on their calendar, not ours, and exhausting one mid-month is a self-inflicted outage with days of warning.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-external-dependency`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-capacity-ticket` (fully automatic) runs when triggered.

Actions: `attach_forecast_chart`, `create_servicenow_task`, `assign_to_owner`.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `sre` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `platform-leadership`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
